description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to be emailed when a site's Agent Readiness Score changes. Sends a confirmation email for monitoring that site. Use only when the user explicitly asks to receive a confirmation email for monitoring at the supplied address. Set sendConfirmationEmail to true only then. Monitoring starts only after the recipient opens the link and confirms on the page; this call itself sends one email.

email.description: Address that will receive the confirmation and the alerts

sendConfirmationEmail.description: True only after the user explicitly requests a monitoring confirmation email.

url.description: Public http(s) address or bare host, for example example.com

name: watch_site
title: Watch a site's score
